the formation of terrestrial planets and their bulk compositions.
the effects of host star elemental abundance variations on the bulk compositions of terrestrial planets.
the formation of terrestrial planets around stars that have a low Mg/Si ratio.

the diversity in host star elemental abundance ratios is likely to be reflected in the composition of the planetary system.
